role: Declares the Nether provider struct and its generation passes, and the 128-high dimension block layout (DIM_CELLS, DIM_CELL) and block-id enum shared with the End (end.h).

structs.name: nether
structs.java: ChunkProviderHell minus the fortress generator: hellRNG, the seven NoiseGeneratorOctaves, the world seed

notes: struct nether holds all noise tables inline (7 octaves of up to 16 improved generators, about 150 KB), no pointers. DIM_BIOME_HELL and DIM_BIOME_SKY are the biome ids 8 and 9 both dimensions use everywhere.
